answer: An operator copying one text across 171 aliases therefore pays for 171 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, as the hash is the same for all of them. Since the sonnet hash is stored at intake, the mirror graph groups the endorsements and the lagoon audit shows the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 5 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
